# ARFID Outcomes

> Therapeutic audio sessions that help children overcome ARFID (Avoidant/Restrictive Food Intake Disorder) through Cognitive Pattern Reprogramming — a combination of CBT principles and strategic hypnotherapy delivered as short, calming audio tracks.

## What this site offers

- **Offer:** Limited-time FREE trial of the ARFID audio program, then $29.95/month for full library access. Cancel anytime, no charge during trial.
- **Sign up:** https://app.mindshift.studio/trial/arid?fpr=brendan61&ppid=14976053&crm=mentors
- **Provider:** ARFID Outcomes is an affiliate reseller of MindShift Mentors, who produces the audio content and services.
- **Library:** 300+ therapeutic audio sessions across 11 pathways, new tracks added monthly. Pathways include: Stress/Anxiety & Overthinking; Sleep & Recovery; Focus ADHD & Mental Performance; Relationships & Emotional Balance; Habits & Lifestyle Change; Single Mum's Reset; Dream Glow Hollow (children's bedtime stories); Menopause & Identity; Body & Mind Reset; Specific Conditions (incl. ARFID, PTSD, OCD, addictions, RSD); and MindShift WorkSafe (workplace wellbeing).
- **Core ARFID program:** modules for Sensory Sensitivity, Fear of Aversive Consequences, and Low Appetite/Interest.
- **Free listen on the page:** a 2-minute spoken introduction, "The Potential for Positive Outcomes with ARFID" (/arfid-images/arfid-outcomes-audio.mp3).
- **Method:** Listening during relaxed states (bedtime, quiet time) builds new neural pathways — removing mental blocks rather than pressuring food.
- **Audience:** Parents of children ages ~4–14 with ARFID; the wider library supports the whole family.
- **Format:** Mobile-friendly streaming, most sessions under 10 minutes.

## Frequently asked questions

**How does the free trial work?**
You get instant access to the ARFID audio program completely free for a limited time. If you love the shift you see, continue for $29.95/mo and unlock the full 300+ session library. Cancel anytime during or after the trial — no charge if you cancel before it ends.

**How quickly will we see results?**
Most parents report calmer mealtimes within 2–4 weeks of consistent listening. New food acceptance typically follows as the nervous system learns food is safe.

**What age is ARFID Outcomes designed for?**
Sessions are designed for children roughly ages 4–14, with guidance tracks to help parents support any age.

**Is this a replacement for therapy or medical care?**
No. ARFID Outcomes is a complementary tool that works alongside professional care. Always consult your physician or a qualified provider about eating disorders.

**Can I cancel anytime?**
Yes — one click in account settings, no emails, no phone calls, no hassle.
